AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

18. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen
